a: Shehifrishu maot lekinnehem, ratza lehavi bahen chattat behema — yavi, olat behema — yavi. met vehayu lo maot setumin — yippelu lindava!
Tanna nazir vechayyayve kinnin dedamu leh, uleappoke meha detanya: mi shehaya mechuyyayv chattat, veamar: "hare alay ola", vehifrish maot veamar "hare ellu lechovati",
Ratza lehavi bahen chattat behema — lo yavi. olat behema — lo yavi. met vehayu lo maot setumim — yelchu leyam hammelach.
Amar rav ashe: ha deamrat meforashin la — la tema deamar "ellu lechattati, veellu leolati, veellu lishlamay". ella afillu amar "ellu lechattati uleolati velishlamay" — meforashin hen.
Veikka deamri, amar rav ashe: la tema ad deamar "ellu lechattati uleolati velishlamay", ella afillu amar: "ellu lechovati" — hare hen kimforashin.
Amar rava: ha daamaran maot setumin yippelu lindava, im nafla deme chattat mibbenehen — hare hen kimforashin.
b: Tanya kevoteh derava: "ellu lechattati vehashshear lishar neziruti", deme chattat — yelchu leyam hammelach, vehashshear — yavi chetzyo leola vechetzyo lishlamim. umoalin bechullan, veen moalin bemiktzatan.
"Ellu leolati vehashshear lishar neziruti", deme ola — yaviu ola, umoalin bahen. vehashshear yippelu lindava, umoalin bechullan, veen moalin bemiktzatan.
Amar rav huna amar rav: lo shanu ella maot, aval behema — hare hi kimforeshet.
Amar rav nachman: ha deamri behema hare hi kimforeshet, lo shanu ella temima, aval baalat mum — hare hi kistuma. aval nesacha — la.

Verav nachman bar yitzchak amar: afillu nesacha, aval sevar shel korot — la. amar leh rav shimi bar ashe lerav pappa: may tamayyhu derabbanan — deamri: maot, velo behema vela nesacha, maot vela sevora? ella meatta: maot velo ofot!
Vechi tema hachi name, ella ha deamar rav chisda: en hakkinnin mitparshot, ella i bilkichat bealim, i baasiyyayt kohen.
Ammay? ha maot gemirin lah!

a: Amar leh: velitamaych, ha ditnan: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hevi shalosh behemot velo peresh, haruya lechattat — tikrav chattat, leola — tikrav ola, lishlamim — tikrav shelamim. ammay? ha amrat: behema lav kimforeshet damya!
Amar leh, hatam: "velakach ... veasa".
Amar rachamana: i bilkichat bealim, i baasiyyayt kohen. hacha name,
b: Mi matzet amrat haden dechattat tikrav ola? hacha nekeva, hacha zachar.

Metiv rav hamenuna: umi amrinan behema baalat mum kistuma damya? ta shema: ketzad amru haish megalleach al nezirut aviv? bizman shehaya hu veaviv nezirim, vehifrish aviv maot linziruto vamet, veamar: "hareni nazir al menat sheagalleach al meot abba".
Hayu lo maot setumot — yippelu lindava. hayta lo behema mufereshet chattat — tamut. ola — tikrav ola, ushelamim — yekarvu shelamim. may lav, afillu baalat mum?
Lo, temima. aval baalat mum, kistuma damya? may irya maot? lema: hayta lo behema baalat mum — yippelu lindava!
Hachi name, baalat mum lemay kaddisha — lidme, deme hayeynu — maot.
Metiv rava: "korbano", bekorbano hu yotze, veeno yotze bekorban aviv. yachol lo yetze bekorbano shel aviv shehifrish min hakkalla al hachamura, o min hachamura al hakkalla,
Aval yotze bekorban shehifrish aviv min hakkalla al hakkalla o min hachamura al hachamura — talmud lomar: "korbano", "korbano". bekorbano hu yotze, veeno yotze bekorbano shel aviv.

Yachol lo yetze bekorban aviv bivhema shehifrish afillu min hakkalla al hakkalla, min hachamura al hachamura, shehare en adam megalleach al behemat aviv binzirut, aval yotze bemaot shehifrish aviv, afillu min hachamura al hakkalla, o min hakkalla al hachamura, shehare adam megalleach al meot aviv binzirut,

a: Bizman shehen setumin velo bizman shehen meforashin — talmud lomar: "korbano". bekorbano hu yotze, veeno yotze bekorban aviv.

Yachol lo yetze bemaot shehifrish afillu min hakkalla al hakkalla, min hachamura al hachamura, aval yotze bekorban shehifrish leatzmo min hakkalla al hachamura, min hachamura al hakkalla — talmud lomar: "korbano ... al chattato", ad sheyyehe korbano leshum cheto.
Yachol lo yetze bivhema shehifrish leatzmo min hakkalla al hakkalla o min hachamura al hachamura, afillu min hakkalla al hachamura o min hachamura al hakkalla,
Shekken im hifrish behema al hachelev vehevi al haddam, o al haddam vehevi al hachelev — shehare lo maal velo kipper,
Aval yotze bemaot shehifrish leatzmo min hakkalla lakkalla, umin hachamura lachamura, min hachamura lakkalla, umin hakkalla lachamura,
Shekken im hifrish leatzmo maot min hachelev vehevi al haddam, al haddam vehevi al hachelev, shehare maal vechipper —
Talmud lomar: "al chattato" — ad sheyyehe korbano leshem cheto.
Katane mihat behema, may lav afillu baalat mum? la, temima.
Aval baalat mum may — kistuma damya? may irya dekatane maot shehifrish aviv? litne baalat mum! hachi name, dilmay chazya — lidme, deme hayeynu maot.
Mishna nizrak aleha echad min haddamim, eno yachol lehafer. rabbi akiva omer: afillu nishchata aleha achat mikkol habbehemot — eno yachol lehafer.

Bamme devarim amurim — betiglachat hattohora, aval betiglachat hattumea — yafer, shehu yachol lomar: i efshi beishsha menuvvevlet. rabbi meir omer: af betiglachat hattohora yafer, shehu yachol lomar: i efshi beishsha megallachat.
Gemara matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer, dei rabbi eliezer, haamar: tiglachat meakkevet. vechevan dela gillecha — asira bechamra. vechevan deit la niuul — matze mefar (uveha peligi),
b: Tanna didan savar: kevan deizderik ala dam, lealtar sharya bechamra, veha let la niuul. verabbi akiva savar: afillu ishtechitat behema — eno yachol lehafer, mishshum hefsed kadashim.

Matkef la rabbi zera: veammay? lizrok daman shello lishman, veyattir basar baachila! mi la tanya: kivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello lishman, o sheshshechatan lifne zemannan o leachar zemannan — haddam yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel.
Veim hayta shabbat — lo yizzarek. veim zarak — huretza, lehaketir emurin laerev!
Amri: i dishchat ola o shelamim — hachi name. ella hacha bemay askinan, kegon sheshshachat chattat beresha.
Keditnan: im gillach al achat mishsheloshtan — yatza.

Bamme devarim amurim — betiglachat tohora. aval betiglachat tumea — yafer (mippene sheyyachol lomar: i efshi beishsha menuvvevlet). verabbi meir omer: afillu betiglachat tohora — yafer, mippene sheyyachol lomar: i efshi beishsha megallachat.
Vetanna kamma amar lach: efshar befea nochrit. verabbi meir savar: befea nochrit, ayyeyde dezuhama — la nicha leh.
Mishna haish maddir et beno benazir, veen haishsha madderet et benah benazir. ketzad? gillach, o sheggillechuhu kerovav. micha, o shemmichu kerovav.
Hayta lo behema mufereshet, hachattat — tamut, vehaola — tikrav ola. ushelamim — yikrevu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lechem.

Hayu lo maot setumin — yippelu lindava. maot meforashim, deme chattat — yelchu leyam hammelach, lo nehenin velo moalin. deme ola — yaviu ola, umoalin bahen, deme shelamim — yaviu shelamim veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lechem.
Gemara ish — in, aval ishsha — la. may tama? rabbi yochanan amar: halacha hi benazir. verabbi yose berabbi chanina

a: Amar resh lakish: kede lechannecho bemitzvot. i hachi, afillu ishsha name! savar: ish chayyayv lechannech beno bemitzvot, veen haishsha chayyevet lechannech et benah.

Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, deamar: halacha hi benazir, ammetu lehachi: beno — in, bitto — la. ella leresh lakish, afillu bitto! kasavar: beno — chayyayv lechannecho, bitto — eno chayyayv lechannechah.
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, deamar: halacha hi benazir, ahachi: binzirut — in, bindarim — la. ella leresh lakish — afillu nedarim name!
La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya bindarim, delet leh niuul, ella afillu binzirut, deit leh niuul — afillu hachi chayyayv lechannecho.
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, deamar: halacha hi benazir, hayeynu dekatane: micha o shemmichuhu kerovav.
Ella lerabbi yose berabbi chanina amar resh lakish, kol keminehon kerovim deamrin leh: la taygmereh mitzvot?! kasavar: kol chinnuch dela chashiv — la nicha leh.
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, deamar: halacha hi benazir, mishshum hachi megalleach veaved hakkafa.
Ella lerabbi yose berabbi chanina amar resh lakish kede lechannecho bemitzvot, ha kaaved hakkafa!
Kasavar: hakkafat kol harosh midderabbanan, vechinnuch midderabbanan. veate chinnuch derabbanan, vedache hakkafa derabbanan.
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, deamar: halacha hi benazir, ahachi megalleach mayyte korban.
Ella lerabbi yose berabbi chanina amar resh lakish, kede lechannecho bemitzvot — ha ka mayyte chullin laazara! kasavar: chullin baazara lav deorayyta.
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, deamar: halacha hi benazir, ahachi ki mittamme mayyte korban tzipporin, veachel kohen melika.
Ella lerabbi yose berabbi chanina amar resh lakish, ha kaachel nevela!
Kasavar kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda, deen shechita laof min hattora. vechullin baazara lav deorayyta.

Vesavar rabbi yose hachi? vehatanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: minnayin lechattat haof shehi baa al hassafek sheenah neechelet — talmud lomar: "vehazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva", makkish nekeva lezachar: ma zachar mevi korban al havvadday — af nekeva mevia korban al havvadday, uma zachar mevi al hassafek — af nekeva mevia al hassafek.

Uma zachar, mimmin shehu mevi al havvadday mevi al hassafek — af nekeva mimmin shehi mevia al havvadday mevia al hassafek. i: ma zachar mevi korban veneechol — af nekeva mevia korban veneechol! amarta:
b: Lo, im amarta bezachar — shekken issur echad, tomar binkeva — sheshshene issurin.
May shene issurin? lav issur nevela vechullin baazara? matkef la rav acha bereh derav ika: vedilma michayyayv aleh, mishshum demitchaze kitren issurin midderabbanan!
Lema ketannae: ad matay maddir et beno benazir — ad sheyyavi shete searot, divre rabbi. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyaggia leonat nedarim.

May lav tannae hi? derabbi savar halacha hi benazir, veaf al gav dehiggia leonat nedarim, maddir leh veazel ad demayyte shete searot. verabbi yose berabbi yehuda, deamar: ad sheyyaggia leonat nedarim, savar kede lechannecho bemitzvot, vechevan denafek mershuteh — tu la michayyayv?
Amri: la. dechulle alma halacha hi benazir, vehacha bemufela hassamuch leish" kamippalgi.
Rabbi savar: mufela hassamuch leish — derabbanan, veatya deorayyta dachaya derabbanan. verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar: mufela hassamuch leish — deorayyta.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma kede lechannecho bemitzvot, umufela hassamuch leish — derabbanan hi. rabbi savar: ate chinnuch derabbanan vedache mufela hassamuch leish derabbanan.
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar ad sheyyaggia leonat nedarim, kasavar: la ate chinnuch derabbanan vedache mufela hassamuch leish.
Lema hane tannae ki hane tannae, detanya: maase berabbi chanina shehiddiro aviv benazir, vehevio lifne rabban gamliel. vehaya rabban gamliel bodko leda im hevi shete searot, im lo hevi.

Rabbi yose omer: leda im higgia leonat nedarim, im lav. amar lo: rabbi, al titztaer levodkeni, im katan ani — ehye bishvil abba, im gadol ani — ehye bishvil atzmi. amad rabban gamliel uneshako al rosho, amar: muvetach ani baze shemmore halacha beyisrael. amru: lo hayu yamim muatim ad shehora horaa beyisrael.

Bishlama lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda, deamar: ad sheyyaggia leonat nedarim, hayeynu dekaamar "im katan ani ehye bishvil abba". ella lerabbi, deamar: ad sheyyavi shete searot — "veim gadol ani ehye bishvil atzmi",

a: Ha birshuteh daavu kaem! ella deamar: ehe bishvil abba, ehe bishvil atzmi.
I ayyti shete searot meikkara — kaem binzirut dileh, ulevassof — kaem binzirut daavu. vei ayyti bemitze may?
Hanicha lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar: ad sheyyaggia leonat nedarim.
Ella lerabbi deamar: ad sheyyavi shete searot, may ikka lememar? amri: lerabbi lekka takkanta ad deyatev dileh veyatev daavuhi.

Mishna haish megalleach al nezirut aviv, veen haishsha megallachat al nezirut aviha. ketzad? mi shehaya aviv nazir, vehifrish maot setumim al neziruto vamet, veamar: "hareni nazir al menat sheagalleach al meot abba".

Amar rabbi yose: hare ellu yippelu lindava, en ze megalleach al nezirut aviv. ezehu shemmegallech al nezirut aviv? mi shehaya hu veaviv nezirim, vehifrish aviv maot setumim linziruto vamet — ze hu shemmegalleach al nezirut aviv.
Gemara may tama? amar rabbi yochanan: halacha hi benazir. peshita! may lememra: deven yoresh et aviv, bat la?
La tzericha, delet leh ella bat. mahu detema: yorshin gemirin lah,
b: Ka mashma lan halacha.
Ibbaya lehu: peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yose, o la peligi? veim timtze lomar peligi, aresha o assefa? ta shema: ketzad amru haish megalleach al nezirut aviv?

Mi shehaya aviv nazir, vehifrish aviv maot linziruto vamet, veamar: "hareni nazir al menat sheagalleach al meot abba" — zehu shemmegalleach al meot aviv. aval mi shehaya hu veaviv nezirim, vehifrish aviv maot linziruto vamet — hare ellu yippelu lindava, divre rabbi yose.
Rabbi eliezer verabbi meir verabbi yehuda amru: ze hu shemmegalleach al meot aviv.
Bae rabba: yesh lo shene vanim nezirim, mahu? hilcheta gemirin la: kol dikdem gallach — gallach, o dilma: yerushsha gemirin la, ufalga have?
Bae rava: bechor ufashut, may? hilcheta gemirin la, vehilkach la bae galloche lefum may deshakel. o dilma: yerushsha hi, vechi hechi deshakel pi shenayim, hachi megallach?
Veim timtze lomar: yerushsha hi, ulefum deshakel megallach, uvechullin hu deit leh pi shenayim, aval behekdesh la. o dilma: kevan dekane leh legilluach, la shena?
Aviv nezir olam vehu nazir setam, aviv nazir setam vehu nezir olam, may? ki gemirin hilcheta, bistam nezirut, o dilma la shena?
Veim timtze lomar: hacha idde veidde, nezirut tohora, bae rav ashe: aviv nazir tame, vehu nazir tahor. aviv nazir tahor, vehu nazir tame, may? teku.
Haderan alach mi sheamar
Bet shammay omrim: hekdesh taut — hekdesh,

a: Uvet hillel omrim: en hekdesh. ketzad? amar "shor shachor sheyyetze mibbeti rishon hare hu hekdesh", veyatza lavan, bet shammay omrim: hekdesh, uvet hillel omrim: eno hekdesh. "dinar zahav sheyyaale beyadi rishon hare hu hekdesh", veala shel kesef, bet shammay omrim: hekdesh, uvet hillel omrim: eno hekdesh. "chavit shel yayin shettaale beyadi rishona hare hi hekdesh", vealta shel shemen, bet shammay omrim: hekdesh, uvet hillel omrim: eno hekdesh.
Gemara bet shammay omrim hekdesh kulei. may tamayyhu devet shammay — deyalfinan techillat hekdesh missof hekdesh. ma temura afillu betaut — af hekdesh afillu betaut.
Uvet hillel omrim: hane mille temura. aval achote hekdesh betaut — la machatinan.
Ulevet shammay, ma illu amar "hare ze tachat ze lachatzi hayyom" mi havya temura mehahi shata? ella ad demate chatzi hayyom hu dehavya temura. hachi name lechi miggalleya milleta!
Amar rav pappa: lechach neemar "rishon" lichsheyyetze rishon.
Veha "shor shachor" kaamar, mi la askinan delet leh ella hay? la tzericha, deit leh teren telata. uvet hillel omrim: im ken, "sheyyetze barishon" mibbee leh.
Amar leh rava mibbarnish lerav ashe: hay hekdesh betaut hu? hekdesh bechavvavna hu! mishshum deatayeh ledibbureh kamma.
Vesavri bet shammay hekdesh betaut la have hekdesh? vehatnan: mi shennadar benazir venishal lachachamim vehittiru, vehayta lo behema mufereshet — tetze vetire baeder.
Amru bet hillel levet shammay: i attem modim shehekdesh betaut hu, vetetze vetire baeder?! michlal desavri bet shammay hekdesh betaut have hekdesh!
Ella bet hillel hu deka tau, savri tamayyhu devet shammay mishshum dehekdesh betaut have hekdesh. veamri lehon bet shammay: lav mishshum hekdesh betaut hu, ella mishshum deatayeh ledibbureh kamma.
Vesavri bet shammay hekdesh betaut la have hekdesh? ta shema: hayu mehallechin badderech,
b: Veechad ba kenegdan, veamar echad: "hareni nazir shezze peloni", veechad amar: "hareni nazir sheen ze peloni", "hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir", "sheen echad mikkem nazir", "sheshshenechem nezirim", "shekkullechem nezirim" — bet shammay omrim: kullam nezirim.
Veha hacha hekdesh betaut hu, vekatane: kullam nezirim! amri: savri bet shammay hekdesh betaut have hekdesh, hacha la.

Abbaye amar: la ka salka datach dekaem betzafra, ella hacha bemay askinan, dekaem betihara, veamar: shor shachor sheyyatza mibbeti rishon leheve hekdesh. vaamaru leh: lavan nefak. vaamar lehon: i hava yadana delavan nefak la amari shachor.
Umi matzet amrat dekaem betihara asek? vehakatane: "dinar shel zahav sheyyaale"! teni "sheala". "chavit shel yayin shettaale"! teni "shealta".

Amar rav chisda: ukkama bechivvara — lakya, chivvara beukkama — lakya. tenan: "shachor sheyyetze mibbeti rishon hekdesh". ka salka datin: ki makdish — beayin raa makdish, veamri bet shammay have hekdesh!
Veella may, beayin yafa makdish? "dinar shel zahav sheyyaale beyadi rishon" veala kesef, bet shammay omrim: hekdesh.

Veella may — beayin raa makdish? chavit shel yayin shettaale beyadi rishon, veala shel shemen, bet shammay omrim: hekdesh. veha shemen adif miyyayin! i mishshum ha la kashya: begalila shanu, dechamra adif mimmishcha.
Resha kashya lerav chisda! amar lecha rav chisda: ki amari — betora dekarmenae.
Veamar rav chisda: ukkama — lemashkeh, summaka — levisreh, chivvara — leridya. vehaamar rav chisda: ukkama bechivvara lakya! ki amari, betora dekarmonae.
Mishna mi shennadar benazir, venishal lechacham vaasaro — mone mishshaa shennadar. nishal lechacham vehittiro, hayta lo behema mufereshet — tetze vetire baeder.

Amru bet hillel levet shammay: i attem modim baze shehu hekdesh taut shettetze vetire baeder?! amar lahen bet shammay: i attem modim bemi shettaa vekara latteshii "asiri", velaasiri "teshii", velaachad asar "asiri", shehu mekuddash?
Amru lahem bet hillel: lo hashshevet kiddesho. uma illu taa vehinniach et hashshevet al shemini veal shenem asar, shemma asa kelum? ella, katuv shekkiddesh haasiri — hu kiddesh hatteshii

a: Veet achad asar.
Gemara manni matnitin? la rabbi yose vela rabbanan.
Detanya: mi shennadar veavar al neziruto — en nizkakin lo, ella im ken mone bahen issur kayyamim shennahag bahem hetter. rabbi yose omer: dayyo sheloshim yom.
I rabbanan, kashya nezirut muetet. i rabbi yose, kashya nezirut merubba!
Ibbaet tema rabbi yose, veibbaet tema rabbanan. ibbaet tema rabbi yose: kan binzirut merubba, kan binzirut muetet.
Veibbaet tema rabbanan: la tema mishshaa shennazar, ella ema kemishshaa shennazar.

Nishal lachachamim vehittiruhu vechulei. amar rabbi yirmeya: middevet shammay nishma lidvet hillel. lav amri bet shammay hekdesh betaut have hekdesh, kevan deiggallay milleta delav shappir nazar — tetze vetire baeder.
Levet hillel name, af al gav deamri temura betaut havya temura — hane mille hecha deiteh leikkar hekdesh. aval hecha demitakar ikkar hekdesh — itakar name temura.
Amar mar: i attem modim sheillu kara latteshii asiri kulei. ittemar: maaser, rav nachman amar: tauto, velo kauonato. rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri: tauto, vechol shekken kauonato.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: ledidach deamrat tauto velo kauonato, dekaamri bet shammay levet hillel: i attem modim sheillu kara latteshii asiri, velaasiri teshii, velaachad asar asiri, sheshshelashtan mekuddashin? veishtiku bet hillel.
Lemru lehon: ma lemaaser shekken eno kadosh bechauona.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: hayeynu tama dela amri lehon, dekal vachomer hu: ma maaser sheeno kadosh bechauona — kadosh betaut, hekdesh, shekkadosh bechauona — lo kol shekken?!
Vela hi, dehekdesh bedata demareh tele.
Mishna mi shennadar benazir, vehalach lehavi et behemto, umetzaah shennigneva. im ad shello nigneva behemto nazar — hare ze nazir.
b: Veim mishshennigneva behemto nazar — eno nazir. vezo taut taa nachum hammadi: keshealu nezirim min haggola umatzu bet hammikdash charev, amar lahem nachum hammadi: illu heyitem yodin shebbet hammikdash charev, heyitem nozrim? amru lo: lo. vehittiran nachum hammadi.
Ucheshebba haddavar etzel chachamim amru: kol shennazar ad shello charav bet hammikdash — nazir. umishshecharav bet hammikdash — eno nazir.
Gemara amar rabba: shatfuhu rabbanan lerabbi eliezer veokmuy beshittayyhu. ditnan: potchin benolad, divre rabbi eliezer, vachachamim osrin.
Veamar rava: af al gav daamur rabbanan en potchin benolad, aval potchin bitnay nolad. hechi dame? amri lehon: illu ata inish vaamar lechon decharav bet hammikdash, mi hava nadritun?
Amar rav yosef: i havay hatam, hava amena lehon: hachtiv "hechal Adonai hechal Adonai hechal Adonai hemma" — ze mikdash rishon umikdash sheni.
Nehi deyadin lehon deyichruv, mi yodin leimmatti?! amar abbaye: vela yadin leimmat? vehachtiv: "shavuim shivim nechtach al ammecha veal ir kodshecha"! veakkatti mi yadinan behe yoma?!

Mishna hayu mehallechin badderech, veechad ba kenegdan, amar echad mehen: "hareni nazir shezze peloni", veechad amar: "hareni nazir sheen ze peloni", "hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir", "sheen echad mikkem nazir", "sheshshenechem nezirim", "shekkullechem nezirim".
Bet shammay omrim: kullan nezirin. uvet hillel omrim: eno nazir ella mi shello nitkayyeymu devarav. verabbi tarfon omer: en echad mehem nazir.
Hirtia laachorav — eno nazir. rabbi shimon omer: yomar "im haya chidvaray — hareni nezir chova, veim lav — hareni nezir nedava".
Gemara mi shello nitkayyeymu devarav, ammay have nazir? amar rav yehuda, ema: mi shennitkayyeymu devarav.

a: Abbaye amar, kegon deamar: "i name lav peloni hu — i have nazir". umay "lo nitkayyeymu devarav" — lo nitkayyeymu devarav harishonim, ella devarav acharonim.
Hirtia laachorav eno nazir kulei. tama mishshum dehirtia laachorav, ha ate lekamman — have nazir. manni?

Ilema rabbi tarfon — mi have nazir? kevan divshata deka nazar la yada i peloni hu vei la, mi chala aleh nezirut? vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon: en echad mehen nazir, lefi shello nittena nezirut ella lehafelaa!
Ella rabbi yehuda dichri hu. detanya: "hareni nazir al menat sheyyehe bakkeri hazze mea kor", vehalach umetzao shennignav o sheavad — rabbi shimon oser, verabbi yehuda mattir.

Rabbi shimon savar kevan deillu lo nignav, dilma havo beh mea kor vehave nazir — hasheta name have nazir. vehacha name kevan dei ata lekamman veyadinan difloni havay, have nazir — hasheta name have nazir.
Mishna raa et hakkoy veamar: "hareni nazir shezze chayya", "hareni nazir shezze eno chayya", "hareni nazir shezze behema", "hareni nazir sheen ze behema".

"Hareni nazir shezze chayya uvehema", "hareni nazir sheen ze lo chayya velo behema", "hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir", "hareni nazir sheen echad mikkem nazir", "hareni nazir shekkullechem nezirin" — hare kullan nezirin.
Gemara tane chada: tisha nezirim, vetanya iddach: tesha neziriyyot. bishlama tisha nezirin — kegon dehave gavre tefe, deittefis veazel beh.
Ella tesha neziriyyot lechad gavra hechi mashkachat la? bishlama shet mashkachat la, keditnan.
Aval telat hechi mashkachat la! amar rav sheshet: kegon deamar "hareni nazir, unezirut hakkol alay".
Haderan alach bet shammay
Shelosha minin asurin bannazir: hattumea, vehattiglachat, vehayyotze min haggefen. vechol hayyotze min haggefen mitztarfin ze im ze. veen chayyayv ad sheyyochal min haanavim kazzayit.
b: Mishna rishona omeret: ad sheyyishte reviit yayin. rabbi akiva omer: afillu shara pitto beyayin veyesh bah kede letzaref kezayit — chayyayv, vechayyayv al hayyayin bifne atzmo, veal haanavim bifne atzman, veal hachartzannim bifne atzman, veal hazzaggim bifne atzman. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: en chayyayv ad sheyyochal shene chartzannim vezag.

Ellu hen chartzannim veellu hen zaggim? hachartzannim — ellu hachitzonim, hazzaggim — ellu happenimim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, shello tite: kezog shel behema; hachitzon zog, vehappenimi inbal.
Gemara shelosha minin asurin bannazir: hattumea kulei. hayyotze min haggefen — in. gefen atzmo — la. matnitin dela kerabbi elazar. detanya, rabbi elazar omer: afillu alin velulavin bammashma.

Ikka deamri la assefa: eno chayyayv ella ad sheyyochal min haanavim kezayit. min haanavim — in, mehaggefen atzmo — la. matnitin dela kerabbi elazar, detanya, rabbi elazar omer: afillu alin velulavin bammashma.

Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi elazar daresh ribbuye umiute, rabbanan darshi kelale uferate. rabbi elazar daresh ribbuye umiute: "miyyayin veshechar yazzir" — miet, "mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin" — ribba.
Miet veribba, ribba hakkol. may ribba — ribba kol mille. may miet — miet shevishata.

Verabbanan darshi kelale uferate: "miyyayin veshechar yazzir" — parat, "mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin" — kalal, "mechartzannim vead zag" — chazar ufarat. perat uchelal uferat, i atta dan ella keen happerat: ma happerat meforash peri ufesolet peri — af kol peri ufesolet peri.

I: ma happerat meforash peri gamur — af kol peri gamur. amarta: im ken ma hinniach lecha hakkatuv bemashmao shello amaro? anavim lachim viveshim — ha ketivi? yayin vachometz — ha ketivi? ha en alecha ladun kelashon acharon, ella kelashon rishon.
Umeachar shessofenu lerabbot kol davar, ma talmud lomar "mechartzannim vead zag"? lomar lach: kol makom sheatta motze perat uchelal — i atta rashshay lemoshcho uleduno keen happerat.
Ella naase kelal musaf al happerat, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv, kederech shepparat lecha bannazir.
Amar mar: ma happerat meforash peri ufesolet peri — af kol peri ufesolet peri. "peri" — inve, "pesolet peri" may hi — chometz.
"Af kol peri" may hi — guharke. "af kol" difsolet peri, may hi? amar rav kahana: leetoye inve dichrin. "vead zag", amar ravina: leetoye deven habbenayim.

Amar mar: [i] ma happerat meforash peri gamur — af kol peri gamur. amarta: im ken ma hinniach hakkatuv bemashmao shello amaro? anavim lachim viveshim — ha ketivi, yayin vachometz — ha ketivi, ha en alecha ladun kelashon acharon ella kelashon rishon. umeachar shessofenu lerabbot kol davar, ma talmud lomar "mechartzannim vead zag"? lomar lach: kol makom sheatta motze perat uchelal, i atta rashshay lemoshcho uleduno keen happerat, ella naase kelal musaf al happerat, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv

a: Kederech shepparat lecha benazir "mechartzannim vead zag". ulerabbi elazar ben azarya deka mokem lehay "mechartzannim vead zag" lomar sheeno chayyayv ad sheyyochal shene chartzannim vezag, perata mena leh! savar la kerabbi elazar dedaresh miet veribba.

Vei baet ema kerabbanan, dei salka datach kidamar rabbi elazar ben azarya, lichteveh rachamana lehay "mechartzannim vead zag" gabbe perate, lemay hilcheta katveh batar kelal? shema minna lemeddayyneh bichlal uferat.

Veema kulleh lehachi hu daata! im ken lichtov o shene chartzannim, o shene zaggim, o chartzan vezag. lemay hilcheta ketav rachamana "mechartzannim vead zag"? shema minna lemidrash beh kelal uferat, veikka name lemidrash beh: ad sheyyochal shene chartzannim vezag.
Verabbi elazar dedaresh miet veribba, perat uchelal uferat mena leh?

Amar rabbi avahu, nafka leh mehay kera: "vechi yitten ish el reehu chamor o shor o se" — parat, "vechol behema" — kalal, "lishmor" — chazar ufarat. perat uchelal uferat, i atta dan ella cheen happerat.
Rava amar: nafka leh mehay kera: "veim min" — parat. "hatztzon" — kalal, "kevashim veizzim" — chazar ufarat,
Perat uchelal ufarat, i atta dan ella cheen happerat.
Amar leh rav yehuda middiskarta lerava, velelaf min haden kera: "min" — parat, "habbehema" — kalal, "bakar vatzon" — chazar ufarat. perat uchelal uferat, i atta dan ella cheen happerat.
Amar leh: min hay lekka lemishma minna, dei mehatam, hava amena: "habbehema" —
b: Chayya bichlal behema.
Amar leh: chayya bichlal behema? ha ketiv "bakar vatzon", vehave leh perat uchelal, vei atta dan ella cheen happerat!
Umenalan dehachi hu? detanya:
"Venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha" — kalal, "babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar" — parat, "uvechol asher tishalcha nafshecha" — chazar vechalal.
Kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat: ma happerat meforash peri mipperi vegiddule karka — af kol peri mipperi vegiddule karka.
Mikkedi kelal uferat uchelal keen perata dayyninan, kelala batra may ahani? ahani leosofe kol dedame leh.
Vetu: perat uchelal uferat keen happerat dayyninan, perata batraa may ahani! i lav perata batraa, hava amena: naase kelal musaf al happerat.
Umikkede, teren kelale uferata uteren perate uchelala — (kelala) keen perata dayyninan, may ikka bene uvene?
Ikka deillu tarten kelale uferata, i ikka perata dedame leh afillu bechad tzad — merabbinan, tere perate uchelala, i ikka perata dedame mishshene tzedadin — merabbinan, bechad tzad — la merabbinan.
Mikkedi perat uchelal — naase kelal musaf al happerat, veitrabbi kol mille. umiet veribba name — ribba hakkol, veitrabbi kol mille. may ikka ben miet veribba lifrat uchelal?
Ikka, deillu perat uchelal — merabbinan afillu alin velulavin. umiet veribba, lulavin — in, alin — la.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: kol issurin shebbattora en hetter mitztaref leissur, chutz meissure nazir, shehare amra tora: "mishrat".

a: Zeeri amar: af seor beval taktiru. keman — kerabbi elazar, dedaresh "kol"?
I hachi leinyan chametz name! in hachi name. ella leappoke meabbaye deamar: yesh haketara befachot mikkezayit, ka mashma lan: en haketara befachot mikkezayit.

Yatev rav dimi vekaamar la leha shemata. etiveh abbaye: hammikpa shel teruma, vehashshum vehashshemen shel chullin, venaga tevul yom bemiktzatan — pasal et kullan. mikpa shel chullin, vehashshum vehashshemen shel teruma, venaga tevul yom bemiktzatan — lo pasal ella mekom maggao.
Vehavenan ba: mekom maggao ammay pasul? veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ma taam — hoil vezar loke aleha bichzayit.
May tameh?
b: Lav mishshum dehetter mitztaref leissur? amar leh: la, may "kezayit" — deikka kezayit bichde achilat peras.
Vaachilat peras deorayyta hi? amar leh: in. i hachi, ammay peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi elazar bechuttach habbavli?
Amar leh: hannach lechuttach habbavli, delekka kezayit bichde achilat peras. i deka saref leh misraf — batla dato etzel kol adam. i mishtar ka shatar — la mashkachat kezayit bichde achilat peras.

Etiveh: shete medochot, achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin. ulefanav shete kederot, achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin, venaflu ellu letoch ellu — shetehen muttarot, sheani omer: chullin letoch chullin naflu, uteruma letoch teruma nafla.
Vei salka datach kezayit bichde achilat peras deorayyta, ammay amrinan "sheani omer"?
Ella may, hetter mitztaref leissur? ammay amrinan "sheani omer"?! ella hannach litrumat tavlin derabbanan hi.

Etiveh: shete kuppot, achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin. ulefanehen shete sein, achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma, venaflu ellu letoch ellu — shenehen muttarin. sheani omer: chullin letoch chullin naflu, teruma letoch teruma nafla.
Vei salka datach kezayit bichde achilat peras asur, ammay amrinan "sheani omer"?

a: Bishlama ledidi deamena mishshum dehetter mitztaref leissur, kegon dinfishi chullin. ella ledidach deamrat mishshum deikka kezayit bichde achilat peras — ki nefishi chullin may have?
Amar leh: hannach litruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan.
Amar leh abbaye: mimmay dehay "mishrat" lehetter mitztaref leissur hu daata? dilma litten taam keikkar hu daata!
Uleabbaye, meikkara ka kashya leh may dekaamar rav dimi, veka motev leh kol halen teyuvata. hadar amar leh, litten taam keikkar?
Batar deshanni leh, amar leh: dilma litten taam kaikkar hu daata?
Lechidtanya: "mishrat" litten taam keikkar, sheim shara anavim bemayim veyesh bahen taam yayin — chayyayv. umikkan atta dan kol issurin shebbattora.

Uma nazir sheen issuro issur olam, veen issuro issur hanaa, veyesh hetter leissuro — asa bo taam keikkar. kile hakkerem, sheissuran issur olam, veissuran issur hanayay, veen hetter leissuran — eno din sheyyaase bo taam keikkar?!
Vehu haddin leorla bishtayim.

Amar leh hahu merabbanan: rabbi avahu ki kaamar lerabbi akiva, he rabbi akiva? ilema rabbi akiva dehacha, ditnan: rabbi akiva omer: afillu shara pitto beyayin veyesh bo kede letzaref kezayit — chayyayv, umimmay? dilma hu deikka kezayit baena!
Vechi tema: may lememra? leappoke mittanna kamma, deamar: ad sheyyishte reviit yayin!
Ella, rabbi akiva devarayyta. detanya, rabbi akiva omer: nazir sheshshara pitto beyayin, veachal kezayit mippat umiyyayin — chayyayv.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: lerabbi akiva deka mokem leh lehay "vechol mishrat" lehetter mitztaref leissur, litten taam keikkar mena leh? yalef mibbasar bechalav. lav taam bealma hu, veasur? hacha name la shena.
Verabbanan, mibbasar bechalav la gamrinan, dechiddush hu.
May chiddusheh? illema dehay lechodeh vehay lechodeh shere, uvahade hadade asur, kilayim name: hay lechodeh shere vehay lechodeh shere, uvahade hadade asur!
Ella: dei taru leh kulle yoma bachalava — shere, umevashshel leh bashshole — asur.
Verabbi akiva name, basar bechalav chiddush hu? ella
b: Yalef miggiule goyim, deamar rachamana: "kol davar asher yavo vaesh", lememra daasiri. giule goyim lav tama bealma hu veasur, hacha name la shena.
Ulerabbanan name tippok lehu miggiule goyim? amar leh: hatam chiddush hu. deha bechol hattora kullah noten taam lifgam muttar,
Vegabbe giule goyim asur.
Ulerabbi akiva name ha chiddush hu! amar rav huna bar chiyyay: lo asra tora ella likdera bat yoma, delav noten taam lifgam hu.
Verabbanan? kedera bat yoma name, i efshar dela pagma pureta.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: midderabbanan nishma lerabbi akiva. lav amri rabbanan hay "mishrat" — litten taam keikkar, umikkan atta dan lechol issurin shebbattora. lerabbi akiva name, deka mokem leh lehay "mishrat" lehetter mitztaref leissur — lema mikkan atta dan lechol issurin shebbattora!
Amar leh: mishshum dehave nazir vechattat shene chetuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin: nazir — ha daamaran. chattat may hi?
Detanya: "kol asher yigga bivsarah yikdash". yachol afillu shello bala — talmud lomar: "bivsarah", ad sheyyibbala bivsarah.
"Yikdash" — lihyot kamoha, sheim pesula hi — yippasel, veim keshera — teachel kechamur shebbah.
Verabbanan: tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana gabbe chattat, hava amena: nazir la ate minna, mishshum denazir mikkodashim la yalfinan.
Vei ketav rachamana gabbe nazir, hava amena: minnazir la yalfinan, mishshum dachamir issureh, daafillu chartzan asir leh, hilkach la atya minneh.

Verabbi akiva amar lach: lemay tzerichi? bishlama i ketav rachamana chattat, la gamar nazir minna — dechullin mikkodashim la gamrinan. ella lichtov rachamana benazir, vetete chattat minneh, deha kol issurin shebbattora ka gamri minnazir.
Verabbanan amri lach: chattat lehetter mitztaref leissur, vechullin mikkodashim la gamrinan.
Umishrat" — litten taam keikkar, mikkan atta dan lechol issurin shebbattora.
Verabbi akiva, tarvayyhu lehetter mitztaref leissur, vehavu lehu shene chetuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbaim keechad — en melammedin.

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: ella ha detanya: "mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin", limmed al issure nazir shehen mitztarfin ze im ze, lerabbi akiva, hasheta yesh lomar hetter mitztaref leissur, issur leissur mibbaya?
Amar leh: hetter leissur — bevat achat, issur leissur — afillu beze achar ze.
Verabbi shimon

a: Delet leh tzeruf, "mikkol asher yease", may daresh beh? amar lach: hahu mibbee leh: leolam eno nazir ad sheyyazzir mikkullan.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: kol reviiyyot shebbattora, en hetter mitztaref leissur, chutz merviit shebbannazir, shehare amra tora "mishrat". may ikka ben rabbi yochanan lerabbi elazar?
Ikka benayyhu, derabbi yochanan merabbi afillu ochalin, verabbi elazar, mashkin — in, midde acharina — la.
Amar rabbi elazar: eser reviiyyot hen, venaket rav kahana bideh chamesh summakata vachamesh chiuorata. chamesh summakata: "nazir veose fesach shehoru bammikdash vametu".

"Nazir" — reviit yayin lenazir. "ose fesach" — deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: arba kosot hallalu tzarich sheyyehe bahen kede reviit. "shehoru" — shata reviit yayin al yore. "bammikdash" — shata reviit yayin venichnas lammikdash chayyayv mita.
"Umetu" — detanya: minnayin lirviit dam sheyyotza mishshene metim shehi metammea beohel, shenneemar: "veal kol nafshot met lo yavo".

Vachamesh chiuorata: "challat nazir umetzora shennifselu beshabbat". "challat" — reviit shemen lechalla. "nazir" — reviit shemen lenazir. metzora — reviit mayim limtzora. "shennifselu" — ditnan: ushear kol hammashkin temein poslin et haggeviyyay birviit.
"Beshabbat" — ditnan: ushear kol hammashkin — birviit, ushear kol hashshofchim — birviit.
Vetu lekka? vehaikka: merviit notlin layyadayim leechad vaafillu lishnayim. biflugeta la ka mayyre.
Veha ikka: haya mevi peyayle shel cheres venoten letochah chatzi log mayim min hakkiyyor, verabbi yehuda omer: reviit. biflugeta la ka mayyre.
Vehaikka: kamma mayim noten letochah — kol shehu, rabbi zakkay omer: reviit! biflugeta la ka mayyre. vehaikka mikve! bar mehahi, devatteluha rabbanan.
b: Veeno chayyayv ella ad sheyyochal min haanavim kezayit vechulei. tanna kamma la medamme lehon lechol issure nazir lishtiyya, verabbi akiva, kevan dichtiv "vaanavim lachim viveshim lo yochel", ma achila kezayit — af kol issurin kezayit.

[Vechayyayv al hayyayin bifne atzmo kulei.] tanu rabbanan: "vaanavim lachim viveshim lo yochel", lechayyev al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo. mikkan atta dan lechol issurin shebbattora: ma kan shehu min echad, vehen shene shemot, vechayyayv al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo; af kol shehu min echad, vehen shene shemot — chayyayv al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo.
Leetoye chamra chadta veinve.
Amar abbaye: achal chartzan — loke shetayim. achal zag — loke shetayim. achal chartzan vezag — loke shalosh. rava amar: eno loke ella achat, sheeno loke allav shebbichlalot.

Metiv rav pappa, rabbi eliezer omer: nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom eno chayyayv ella achat. amru lo: "al tishte" "al tishte", vehu shote — chayyayv al kol achat veachat. achal anavim lachim viveshim, chartzannim vezaggim, vesachat eshkol shel anavim veshata — loke chamesh. i hachi — lilke shesh, achat al "mikkol asher yaase".
Tena veshayyayr. may shayyer dehay shayyayr? shayyayr "lo yachel devaro".
I mishshum hay — lav shiyyura hu, ki katane midde dela iteh beducheta achariti, "lo yachel devaro" iteh bindarim.
Amar leh ravina mipparzikya lerav ashe: veha shayyayr deven habbenayim. ella amar rav pappa: la tanya midde chamesh. veha

a: Otveh chamesh, umeachar dela tanya chamesh, may tama otveh? amar rav pappa: ana sevari lav gemara hi bideh, vehadar beh. vela yadana digmara hi bideh, vela hadar beh.
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer kulei. amar rav yosef: keman metargeminan "mippuretznin vead itztzurin" — kerabbi yose.
Mishna setam nezirut — sheloshim yom. gillach o sheggillechuhu listim — soter sheloshim yom. nazir sheggillach ben bezug ben betaar, o shessifsef kol shehu — chayyayv.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: hay mazya milletachat rave o milleel? lemay nafka minna? lenazir sheggillechuhu listim veshiyyeyru bo kede lachof rosho leikkaro.
I amrat milletachat rave — nezirut ha shakleh. ella i amrat milleel rave — may deakdesh ha kaem.
Ta shema meha inba chayya dekaem beikba devinta, vei salka datach milletachat rave — beresha devinta bae lemekam. leolam milletachat rave veaggav chayyuta nachet veazel inba.
Ta shema inba meta beresha devinta, vei salka datach milleel rave — beikba devinta bae lemekam. hatam name, mishshum delet ba chela saroge sarega veazel.
Ta shema mibbelorit dechushiyyim, devatar dimgaddelin la rafya milletachat. hatam name, ayyeyde dekamta hi mishshichva derafya.
Ta shema missekarta, derafe amra milletachat, vetanya. vetu: kad tzavi savayya diknehon chavvran
b: Ikve nimhon, shema minna milletachat rave. shema minna.

Veella ha detanya: nazir sheggillechuhu listim, veshiyyeyru bo kede lachof rosho leikkaro — eno soter. vei salka datach milletachat rave, listor! kegon sheggillechuhu achar melot. umanni — rabbi eliezer hi, deamar: kol achar melot shiva soter.
May tama derabbi eliezer? yalef tiglachat tohora mittiglachat tumea. ma tiglachat tumea shiva, af tiglachat tohora — shiva.
Vekim lehu lerabbanan kol shiva yomin atya mazyay kede lachof rosho leikkaro.

Nazir sheggillach ben betaar ben bezug, o shessifsef kol shehu — chayyayv. tanu rabbanan: "taar", en li ella taar. talash, merat, sifsef kol shehu, minnayin — talmud lomar: "kadosh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho", divre rabbi yoshiyya.
Rabbi yonatan omer: "taar", en li ella taar. merat, talash, sifsef kol shehu — patur. vehachtiv "kadosh yihye"! memra deim gillach leh betaar — kaem aleh baase velo taase.

Tanya iddach: "taar", en li ella taar. talash, merat, sifsef kol shehu, minnayin — talmud lomar: "lo yaavor al rosho". umeachar shessofenu lerabbot kol davar, ma talmud lomar "taar lo yaavor al rosho"?
Lefi shello lamadnu letiglachat haacharona sheyyihye betaar. lelammedo mimmetzora — i efshar,

a: Sheen danin kal mechamur lehachemir alav.
Rabbi omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "taar lo yaavor al rosho ad melot", hattora amra: "achar melot" — lo tehe tiglachat ella betaar.
Vehachtiv "taar lo yaavor al rosho"!
Laavor alav bishne lavin.
Amar rav chisda: lilkot — beachat, leakkev — bishtayim, listor — eno soter ella berov rosho uvetaar.
Betaar — in, bemidde acharina — la? vehakatane: minnayin lerabbot et kol hammaavirin! ella ema: keen taar.

Tanya name hachi: nazir shettalash, merat, sifsef kol shehu — eno soter ella berov rosho uvetaar. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: keshem sheshte searot meakkevot bo, kach shete searot sotrot bo.
Tenan hatam: shelosha megallechin, vetiglachtan mitzva: nazir, umetzora, uleviyyim. vechullan sheggillechu shello betaar, o sheshshiyyeyru shete searot — lo asu velo kelum.
Amar mar: shelosha megallechin vetiglachtan mitzva. peshita! mahu detema mishshum abbore sear hu, vaafillu sach nasha, ka mashma lan dela.
Katane: vechullan sheggillechu shello betaar. bishlama gabbe nazir, ketiv: "taar lo yaavor al rosho". vegabbe leviyyim ketiv: "veheeviru taar al kol besaram". ella metzora betaar, menalan?

Vechi tema, tete milleviyyim: ma leviyyim shekken teunin tiglachat, veen tiglachtan ella betaar — af ani avi et hametzora shehu taun tiglachat, veen tiglachto ella betaar. ikka lemifrach: ma lilviyyim shekken teunin tenufa begufam, tomar bimtzora dela!
Ella tete minnazir: ma lenazir shekken korbano taun lechem, tomar bimtzora dela. ella mechada la atya, tete mittarvehon.
Mehe tete? tete milleviyyim, ma lilviyyim shekken teunin tenufa begufan. nazir yochiach, ma lenazir shekken korbano taun lechem. leviyyim yochichu.
Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahem shehen teunin tiglachat, vetiglachtan betaar. af ani avi et hametzora shehu taun tiglachat, vetiglachto betaar.
Amar leh rava mibbarnish lerav ashe, velifroch: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken
b: En korbano bedallut. tomar bimtzora shekkorbano bedallut!
Amar leh rava bar mesharsheya lerava: hay tanna, meikkara amar: lelomdo mimmetzora i efshar, sheen danin kal mechamur lehachemir alav. vahadar amar: nelaf middina, umiddina name la yalef?
Amar leh: hahu — allibba derabbanan. ha — allibba derabbi eliezer. ditnan: veeno chayyayv ad sheyyelakketennu betaar. rabbi eliezer omer: afillu likketo bemalket uverahitne — chayyayv.
May tamayyhu derabbanan? detanya: "zekano" ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu", yachol afillu metzora ken — talmud lomar: "zekano".
Umenalan divtaar? detanya: "ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu", yachol afillu gillecho bemisparayim yehe chayyayv, talmud lomar: "velo tashchit".
Yachol likketo bemalket uverahitne yehe chayyayv, talmud lomar: "ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu". ha ketzad? ezehu gilluach sheyyesh bo hashechata — heve omer: ze taar.
Mimmay? dilma leolam afillu likketo bemalket uverahitne name mitzva kaaved, veha kaate leashmoinan daafillu betaar la michayyayv aleh!
Amri: i salka datach ki aved name bemalket uverahitne shappir dame, lishtok kera minneh, vaana amena: uma gabbe nazir deissura ka aved, afillu hachi michayyayv, hacha demitzva — lo kol shekken?

a: Vetu, i salka datach ki aved bemalket uverahitne — mitzva ka aved, middela ketiv "taar", keresh lakish, deamar:
Kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase, im atta yachol lekayyem et shenehem — mutav, veim lav — yavo ase veyidche et lo taase.
Verabbi eliezer may tama? yalef merosho". detanya: "rosho", ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar gabbe nazir "taar lo yaavor al rosho", yachol af nazir metzora ken — talmud lomar: "rosho".

Mimmay? dilma leolam afillu likketo bemalket uverahitne — mitzva kaaved. vechi tema: taar lema li — lememra daafillu betaar. salka datach amena, hoil vegabbe nazir ki aved betaar michayyayv, gabbe metzora name lichayyayv, ka mashma lan dela!
I salka datach ki aved bemalket uverahitne mitzva kaaved, middela ketav "taar", keresh lakish.
Verabbanan hay "rosho", may darshi beh? mibbee lehu lemidche lav dehakkafa. detanya: "lo takkifu peat roshchem", yachol af metzora ken — talmud lomar: "rosho".
Lema li lemichtav "rosho"? vetippok leh mizzekano". detanya: "zekano", ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu", yachol af metzora ken — talmud lomar: "zekano".
Lema li lemichtav "rosho" ulema li lemichtav "zekano"? tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana "zekano" vela ketav "rosho", hava amena: hakkafat kol harosh lo shemah hakkafa. lehachi ketav rachamana "rosho".
b: Vei ketav "rosho" vela ketav "zekano", hava amena: mashma tarte: deate ase vedache et lo taase, umashma dehakkafat kol harosh shemah hakkafa. veakkatti betaar menalan? lehachi ketav rachamana "zekano".
Verabbi eliezer, deate ase vedache et lo taase menaleh? yalef miggedilim". detanya: "lo tilbash shaatnez",

a: Ha "gedilim taase lach" mehem.
Amar mar: vechullam sheggillechu shello betaar, o sheshshiyyeyru shete searot — lo asu velo chelum. amar rav acha bereh derav ika: zot omeret, rubbo kechullo middeorayyta.
Mimmay — middegalli rachamana gabbe nazir "beyom hashshevii yegallechennu" — hacha hu dead deikka kullo. ha bealma: rubbo kechullo.

Matkef la rabbi yose berabbi chanina: hay benazir tame ketiv! machachu ala bemareva: mikkede nazir tame divtaar menalan — minnazir tahor yalef, layte nazir tahor velelaf minnazir tame: ma tame ki shayyayr shete searot — vela kelum avad, hacha name, ki shayyayr shete searot — vela kelum avad.
Bae abbaye: nazir sheggillach veshiyyer shete searot, tzamach rosho vechazar vegillechan, mahu? mi meakkevi o la?
Bae rava: nazir sheggillach vehinniach shete searot, vegillach achat venashra achat, mahu? amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: gillach saara saara ka mibbee leh lerava?
Ella ema: nashra achat vegillach achat, mahu? amar leh: gilluach en kan, sear en kan. i sear en kan — gilluach yesh kan! hachi kaamar: af al pi shessear en kan, mitzvat gilluach en kan.
Mishna nazir chofef umefaspes, aval lo sorek.
Gemara chofef umefaspes, manni? rabbi shimon hi, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven — muttar. aval lo sorek — atan lerabbanan.
Resha rabbi shimon vesefa rabbanan? amar rabba: kullah rabbi shimon hi, kol hassorek — lehasir nimin meduledalot mitkavven.
Mishna rabbi yishmael omer: lo yachof baadama, mippene shemmashsheret et hassear.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: "mippene shehi mashsheret et hassear" tenan, o dilma: "mippene hammashsheret" tenan? lemay nafka minna?
Kegon deikka adama dela mattera. i amrat "mippene shehi mashsheret" tenan, hecha deyadinan dela mattera — shappir. ella i amrat "mippene hammashsheret" — kelal kelal la. teku.

Mishna nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom — eno chayyayv ella achat. amru lo: "al tishte" "al tishte", vehu shote — chayyayv al kol achat veachat. haya megalleach kol hayyom — eno chayyayv ella achat. amru lo: "al tegalleach" "al tegalleach", vehu megalleach — chayyayv al kol achat veachat. haya mittamme lemetim kol hayyom — eno chayyayv ella achat. amru lo: "al tittamme" "al tittamme", vehu mittamme — chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
b: Gemara ittemar, amar rabba amar rav huna: mikra male dibber hakkatuv: "lo yittamma". keshehu omer "lo yavo" — lehazehiro al hattumea, lehazehiro al habbia. aval tumea vetumea — lo.

Verav yosef amar: haelohim! amar rav huna: afillu tumea vetumea. deamar rav huna: nazir shehaya omed bevet hakkevarot, vehoshitu lo meto umet acher venaga bo — chayyayv. ammay? ha mittamme vekaem! ella lav shema minna, amar rav huna: afillu tumea vetumea.

Etiveh abbaye: kohen shehaya lo met munnach al ketefo, vehoshitu lo meto umet acher venaga bo, yachol yehe chayyayv — talmud lomar: "velo yechallel", bemi sheeno mechullal, yatza ze shehu mechullal veomed.
Amar leh: vetikshe lach matnitin, ditnan: haya mittamme lemetim kol hayyom — eno chayyayv ella achat. amru lo "al tittamme" "al tittamme" — chayyayv al kol achat veachat. veammay? ha mittamme vekaem!
Ella kashya ahadade! la kashya: kan — bechibburin. kan — shello bechibburin.
Vetumea bechibburin deorayyta? ha amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yannay: lo amru tumea bechibburin ella litruma vekadashim, aval lenazir veose fesach — la. vei amrat deorayyta, may shena?
Kan, bechibbure adam beadam. kan, bechibbure adam bemet.
Aval tumea vetumea la, deha mittamme vekaem.
Tumea uvia name, ha mittamme vekae! amar rabbi yochanan: kan bevayit,
Kan besade.

a: Bevayit name, kevan deael yedeh — istaav, ki ayel kulle, hay tame hu!
Ella amar rabbi elazar: tzeraf yado, mishshum tumea — ikka, mishshum bia — lekka. vetzeraf gufo — tumea uvia bahade hadade kaatu. ha i efshar dela ayel chotmo beresha, venachet leh tumea!
Ella amar rava: hichnis yado, mishshum tumea — ikka, mishshum bia — lekka. hichnis gufo — tumea uvia bahade hadade ka atyayn. veha i efshar dela ayel etzbeata dechareh beresha venachet lehu tumea!

Ella amar rav pappa: kegon shennichnas beshidda teva umigdal, uva chavero ufara alav et hammaaziva, detumea uvia bahade hadade kaatyayn. mar bar rav ashe amar: kegon deayel keshehu goses, unefak nishmeteh addeyatev. detumea uvia bahade hadade kaatyayn.
Tanu rabbanan: "lehechallo", ad shaa sheyyamut. rabbi omer: "bemotam yittamma", ad sheyyamut.

May benayyhu? amar rabbi yochanan: mashmaut dorshin ikka benayyhu. resh lakish amar: goses ikka benayyhu. leman deamar millehechallo" — afillu goses, leman deamar "bemotam" — ad sheyyamut in, goses la.
Uleman deamar millehechallo", hachtiv "bemotam"! mibbee leh lechidrabbi. detanya, rabbi omer: bemotam eno mittamme, aval mittamme benigatam uvezivatam.
Uleman deamar "bemotam", ha mibbee leh lehay sevara! im ken, lema kera "bemot", may "bemotam" — shamat minna tarte.
Uleman deamar "bemotam", hachtiv "lehechallo"! "lehechallo" lehachi hu daata, bemi sheeno mechullal, yatza ze shemmechullal veomed.
Uleman deamar millehechallo", ha mibbee leh lehay sevara! im ken lema kera "lehechel", may "lehechallo" — shamat minna tarte.

Metivi: adam eno metamme (ella) ad shettetze nafsho. vaafillu meguyyayd vaafillu goses. uleman deamar millehechallo" ha katane deeno metamme! leinyan tammoye — ad denafka nafsheh, leinyan ittachole — ha ittachil.
b: Amar rav chisda amar rav: nikta rosho shel aviv — eno mittamme lo. may tama — amar kera: "leaviv", bizman shehu shalem, velo bizman shehu chaser. amar leh rav hamenuna: ella meatta, kaazel befakta daaravot, ufasku gannave leresheh, hachi name dela litamme leh?
Amar leh: met mitzva kaamrat? hasheta yesh lomar: beachrine michayyayv, beaviv lo kol shekken?
Vehay met mitzva hu? vehatanya: ezehu met mitzva — kol sheen lo kovrin. kore vaacherim onin oto — en ze met mitzva. veha it leh bera! kevan dekaazel beorcha — kemi sheen lo kovrim dame.
Metivi: "lah yittamma", lah hu mittamme, veeno mittamme leevareha. lefi sheeno mittamme leever min hachay shel aviv. aval mechazzer hu al etzem kisora.
May "mechazzer hu al etzem kisora"? lav lememra dei michassar pureta?
La, hahi rabbi yehuda hi. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: lah mittamme, veeno mittamme leevareha. sheeno mittamme al ever min hachay shel aviv, aval mittamme hu leever min hammet shel aviv.
Vehatanya, rav kahana berabbi eliezer ben yaakov: lah mittamme, veeno mittamme leevarim. perat lichzayit min hammet, uchezayit netzel, umelo tarvod rakav.
Yachol lo yittamme lashshidra velaggulegolet ulerov binyaynah ulerov minyaynah — ketiv: "veamarta alehem", hosif lecha hakkatuv tumea acheret.

a: Yachol lo yittamme lashshidra velaggulegolet ulerov binyayno ulerov minyayno shel acherim. amarta: ma achoto meyuchedet sheggufa taluy bo, umittamme lashshidra velaggulegolet ulerov binyaynah ulerov minyaynah, af kol sheggufo taluy bo — mittamme lashshidra velaggulegolet ulerov binyayno ulerov minyayno.

Hahi name rabbi yehuda hi. verav deamar ki hay tanna detanya: maase shemmet aviv shel rabbi yitzchak beginzak, uvau vehodiuhu leachar shalosh shanim, uva veshaal et rabbi yehoshua ben elisha vearbaa zekenim [sheimmo],
Veamru: "leaviv" — bizman shehu shalem, velo bizman shehu chaser.

Mishna shelosha minin asurin bannazir: hattumea, vehattiglachat, vehayyotze min haggefen. chomer battumea uvattiglachat mibbayyotze min haggefen, shehattumea vehattiglachat — sotrin, vehayyotze min haggefen — eno soter.
Chomer bayyotze min haggefen mibbattumea uvattiglachat, shehayyotze min haggefen lo huttar mikkelalo, vetumea vetiglachat hutteru mikkelalan betiglachat mitzva uvemet mitzva.
Vechomer battumea mibbattiglachat, shehattumea soteret et hakkol, vechayyayvin aleha korban. vetiglachat enah soteret ella sheloshim, veen chayyayvin aleha korban.
Gemara vetumea lo tuttar mikkelalah, kal vachomer miyyayin: uma yayin sheeno soter lo huttar mikkelalo, tumea shessoteret — eno din shello tuttar mikkelalah?
Talmud lomar: "leaviv uleimmo lo yittamma". leaviv uleimmo lo yittamma, aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva.

Veyayin yuttar mikkelalo, kal vachomer mittumea: ma tumea shehi soteret — huttera mikkelalah, yayin sheeno soter — eno din sheyyuttar mikkelalo? amar kera: "miyyayin veshechar yazzir", leesor yen mitzva keyen reshut.
Veyayin yistor et hakkol, kal vachomer mittumea: ma tumea shehuttera mikkelalah — soteret et hakkol, yayin shello huttar mikkelalo — lo kol shekken sheyyistor?
Amar kera: "vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ki tame nizro", tumea soteret veen hayyayin soter.

Vehattiglachat tistor et hakkol, kal vachomer mittumea: uma tumea shello asu bah metamme kammittamme — soteret et hakkol, tiglachat, sheasu bah megalleach kammitgalleach — eno din shettistor et hakkol?
Amar kera: "vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ki tame nizro", tumea soteret et hakkol, veen tiglachat soteret et hakkol.

Vetumea naase bah metamme kammittamme, kal vachomer mittiglachat: uma tiglachat sheenah soteret ella sheloshim — asa bah megalleach kammitgalleach, tumea, shehi soteret et hakkol — eno din shennaase bah metamme kammittamme?
Amar kera: "vetimme rosh nizro", limtamme rosh nizro.

Vetiglachat lo naase bah megalleach kammitgalleach, kal vachomer mittumea: uma tumea, shehi soteret et hakkol — lo asu bah metamme kammittamme, tiglachat, sheenah soteret ella sheloshim yom — lo kol shekken shello naase megalleach kammitgalleach?
Amar kera: "taar lo yaavor al rosho", keri beh: lo yaavor hu, velo yaavor leacher.

Vetiglachat lo tuttar mikkelalah, kal vachomer miyyayin: uma yayin sheeno soter — lo huttar mikkelalo, tiglachat shessoteret — eno din shello tuttar mikkelalah? amar rachamana: "rosho", veamar rachamana: "zekano".
Vetiglachat lo tistor kelal, kal vachomer miyyayin: uma yayin shello huttar mikkelalo — eno soter, tiglachat shehuttera mikkelalah — eno din shello tistor? bainan giddul sear, veha lekka.

Veyayin yistor sheloshim yom, kal vachomer mittiglachat: uma tiglachat shehuttera mikkelalah — soteret, yayin, shello huttar mikkelalo — eno din sheyyistor? midde hu tama ella mishshum giddul sear, gabbe yayin ha kaem searo.
b: Mishna tiglachat tumea ketzad? haya mazze bashshelishi uvashshevii umegalleach bashshevii, umevi korbenotav bashshemini. veim gillach bashshemini — mevi korbenotav bo bayyom, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi tarfon: ma ben ze limtzora?
Amar lo: ze tohorato teluya beyamav, umetzora tohorato teluya betiglachto. veeno mevi korban ella im ken haya meorav shemesh.
Gemara kaybla minneh o la? ta shema: detane hillel: gillach bashshemini — mevi korbenotav batteshii. vei salka datach kaybla minneh, layte korbenotav bashshemini!
Amar rava, la kashya: ha — detaval bashshevii, ha — delo taval bashshevii.

Amar abbaye: ashkachtinhu lechavreh derav natan bar hoshaya deyatvin vekaamrin: "uva lifne Adonai el petach ohel moed unetanam el hakkohen", ematay hu [ba]? bizman shehu taval veasa heerev shemesh — in, lo taval veasa heerev shemesh — la.
Alma kasavar tevul yom shel zav — kezav dame.
Amena lehon ana: ella meatta gabbe nazir tame name, dichtiv: "(vehevi otam) el hakkohen el petach ohel moed". ematay hu [ba] — bizman shettaval veasa heerev shemesh.

a: Mikkede shaare nikanor hecha kayymin — beshaare leviyyay.

Vehatanya: teme met muttar likkanes bemachane leviyyay, velo teme met bilvad ella afillu met atzmo, shenneemar: "vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo", may "immo" — immo bimchitzato, immo bemachane leviyyay.
Ella (amar abbaye): tevul yom shel zav — kezav dame. vaafillu hachi, kevan dimchussar kappara — la ayel.
Vei bemachane leviyyay kae, ammay ka kare leh "ohel moed"? lememra: ma hatam — mechussar kappara la ayel, af lemachane leviyyay name — mechussar kappara la ayel.
Vehatam menalan? detanya: "tame yihye" — lerabbot tevul yom, "od tumeato bo" — lerabbot mechussar kappara.

Mishna tiglachat hattohora ketzad? haya mevi shalosh behemot: chattat, ola, ushelamim. veshochet et hashshelamim umegalleach alehem, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi elazar omer: lo haya megalleach ella al hachattat, shehachattat kodemet bechol makom. veim gillach al achat mishsheloshtan — yatza.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hevi shalosh behemot velo peresh, haruya lechattat — tikrav chattat, leola — tikrav ola, lishlamim — tikrav shelamim.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vegillach hannazir petach ohel moed vegomer", bishlamim hakkatuv medabber, shenneemar: "ushechato petach ohel moed".
Atta omer bishlamim hakkatuv medabber, o eno ella petach ohel moed mammash? amarta: im ken — derech bizzayon hu.
Rabbi yoshiyya omer: eno tzarich, hare amra tora "lo taale vemaalot al mizbechi", kal vachomer lederech bizzayon.

[50"1 Bammidrash befarasha naso (daf 240"2): "vegillach hannazir", rabbi yoshiyya omer: bishlamim hakkatuv medabber. o eno vechulei. im kach, amra tora "lo taale vechulei" — kal vachomer laddavar shello yegalleach petach ohel moed, ella bishlamim hakkatuv medabber.]
Rabbi yitzchak omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "velakach et sear rosh nizro venatan al haesh vegomer", mi sheeno mechussar ella lekicha unetina. yatza ze, shehu mechussar lekicha, havaa, unetina.

Ikka deamri, rabbi yitzchak omer: bishlamim hakkatuv medabber. atta omer bishlamim hakkatuv medabber, o eno ella petach ohel moed mammash? talmud lomar: "velakach et sear rosh nizro", mekom shehaya mevashshel — sham haya megalleach.
Abba chanan omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: "vegillach hannazir petach ohel moed", kol zeman sheen petach ohel moed patuach — eno megalleach.
Rabbi shimon shezuri omer: "vegillach hannazir petach ohel moed", velo nezira,
b: Shemma yitgaru bah pirche chehunna. amar lo: lidvarecha sota tochiach, dichtiv bah "veheemidah lifne Adonai", vela chayyshinan shemma yitgaru bah pirche chehunna!
Amar lahen: zo kochelet ufokeset, zo enah kochelet ufokeset.

Mishna haya notel sear rosh nizro umeshalleach tachat haddud. veim gillach bammedina — lo haya meshalleach tachat haddud. bamme devarim amurim? betiglachat hattohora, aval betiglachat hattumea — lo haya meshalleach tachat haddud.
Rabbi meir omer: hakkol meshallechin tachat haddud, chutz min hattame shebbammedina bilvad.

Gemara notel sear rosh nizro. tanu rabbanan: veachar kach notel et harotev venoten al sear rosh nizro, umeshalleach tachat haddud shel shelamim. veim shillach tachat haddud shel chattat veasham — yatza. asham benazir [tahor] mi ikka? amar rava, hachi kaamar: veim nazir tame meshalleach tachat haddud shel asham — yatza.
Mena hane mille? amar rava, amar kera: "asher tachat zevach hashshelamim", mizzivcho yehe tachtav.

Veim shillach tachat haddud shel chattat — yatza. may tama? amar kera: "zevach", lerabbot et hachattat veasham. veha appekteh lehay "zevach" merotev! im ken lema kera "merotev hashshelamim", may "zevach" — shema minna lerabbot chattat veasham.
Veema kullah lechattat veasham hu daata! im ken, lema "shelamim vezevach", may "zevach hashshelamim" — shema minna tarte.

Tanu rabbanan: hakkol hayu meshallechin tachat haddud, chutz mittame sheggillach bimdina, mippene shessearo nikbar, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: tehorim kan vechan — hayu meshallechin. temeim kan vechan — lo hayu meshallechin. vachachamim omrim: hakkol lo hayu meshallechin tachat haddud, chutz min tahor shebbammikdash, mippene shennaasa kemitzvato.

Mishna haya mevashshel et hashshelamim o sholkan. hakkohen notel et hazzeroa beshela min haayil, vechalla matztza achat min hassal, urekik matztza achat, venoten al kappe hannazir, umenifan, veachar kach huttar hannazir lishtot yayin ulehittamme lammetim.
